With 43 years of experience in the international market and 20 years in Romania, HN Services means:
Digital transformation and IT professionals
Diversity of technical roles;
Wide IT market exposure in different domains of activity;
A dedicated internal training center for software development.
 💡 We, at HN Services Romania, are expanding our team, and we are looking for new, experienced Technical Business Analyst with french who is passionate about delivering high-quality solutions
 Overview: 
 The department covers all non-banking-specific corporate IT and management solutions for the Group, with a wide portfolio of activities including:
PeopleSoft suite
Software as a Service (SaaS) management
Data management and analytics
Tool development
 As a Business Analyst, you will act as the key link between business objectives and information technology, ensuring that technical solutions align with organizational and operational needs.
 Responsibilities 
Elicit, analyze, document, and manage business requirements, translating stakeholder and customer needs into effective products, services, and system enhancements
Collaborate with stakeholders, project teams, and technical partners to define requirements, propose efficient solutions, and support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications
Contribute to successful project delivery by ensuring that business needs are clearly understood and addressed through practical and value-driven technical solutions
 Requirements 
 Business Analysis & Functional Skills 
Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements
Ability to translate business needs into functional and technical solutions
Understanding of business processes, systems, and project lifecycles
Experience working with stakeholders, business teams, and IT teams
Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies
Requirements analysis and process mapping
Ability to facilitate workshops and manage priorities
Understanding of system implementation, testing, and change management
 Technical Skills 
Strong SQL skills, including:
Joins
Aggregations
Window functions
Other SQL operations
Intermediate knowledge of data warehousing patterns, including:
Snapshots
Point-in-Time tables (PITs)
Incremental loads
Change Data Capture (CDC) / Delta detection
Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications
General understanding of data consumption and integration models, including:
APIs
Flat files
Other integration models
 Tools 
Jira
Visio
 Preferred Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role
Knowledge of data analysis
Experience in digital transformation or process improvement projects
 Soft Skills 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to facilitate workshops
Ability to manage priorities
